notes: Calories are estimates per WHOLE cookie until recipes are finalized. Never present them per serving.
shared_kitchen_statement: Everything is baked in a shared kitchen with milk, egg, wheat, soy, tree nuts and peanuts, so we can't guarantee any cookie is free of an allergen.

flavors.name: Le Classique
flavors.description: Brown-butter cookie, semi-sweet chocolate chunks, flaky sea salt.
flavors.look: Golden-brown thick cookie, glossy melted chocolate pools, white salt flakes, crackled edges.

flavors.name: Concha Rosa
flavors.description: Vanilla sugar cookie with a pink concha-style crackle topping.
flavors.look: Pale golden cookie with a pastel pink sugar crust scored in the concha shell pattern.

flavors.name: Cajeta Praliné
flavors.description: Goat-milk caramel (cajeta) swirl cookie with toasted pecan praline.
flavors.look: Amber caramel cookie, glossy cajeta drizzle ribbons, chopped pecans on top.

flavors.name: Fraise Crème
flavors.description: Strawberry cookie, cream-cheese frosting, freeze-dried strawberries.
flavors.look: Soft pink cookie base, thick white frosting swoop, red freeze-dried strawberry crumbs.

flavors.name: Chocolat de Oaxaca
flavors.description: Double-chocolate cookie with stone-ground cinnamon chocolate and a whisper of ancho chile.
flavors.look: Very dark cocoa cookie with a crinkled, cracked top, gritty dark chocolate shards, a dusting of cinnamon sugar and a few red ancho flecks.

flavors.name: Horchata Sablé
flavors.description: Buttery rice-milk sablé rolled in cinnamon sugar, finished with a horchata glaze.
flavors.look: Pale cream cookie fully coated in sparkly cinnamon sugar, a thin translucent white glaze drizzle in loose lines, cinnamon specks.

flavors.name: Pan de Muerto
flavors.description: Orange-blossom butter cookie with an anise sugar crust and the classic bone-shaped topping.
flavors.look: Golden domed cookie heavily coated in coarse white sugar, with raised crossed 'bone' dough ridges and a small round knob in the center, like pan de muerto.

flavors.name: Café de Olla Brûlée
flavors.description: Piloncillo-coffee cookie with a crackly brûléed sugar top and cinnamon.
flavors.look: Mocha-brown cookie with a glassy, amber caramelized sugar disc on top, cracked like crème brûlée, one cinnamon stick piece as garnish.

flavors.name: Mangonada
flavors.description: Mango sugar cookie with a chamoy glaze and a chile-lime sugar rim.
flavors.look: Bright yellow-orange cookie, glossy deep red chamoy glaze pooled in the center, red chile-lime sugar around the rim, a few small mango cubes.

flavors.name: Mazapán Rosé
flavors.description: Rose-scented sugar cookie topped with crumbled peanut mazapán and dried rose petals.
flavors.look: Pale blush cookie with a sandy, pale-tan crumbled mazapán topping, scattered dried pink rose petals, a light powdered sugar dusting.
